symbols.name: ring indeterminate
symbols.meaning: The variable of the polynomial ring whose powers serve as roots of unity in the remaining axes.
symbols.quote: Here $y$ is the variable of the ring, whose powers serve as roots of unity in the remaining axes.

symbols.name: coefficient count
symbols.meaning: The number of complex coefficients in the coefficient list of one polynomial record, a power of two.
symbols.quote: $r$ is the number of coefficients in the coefficient list of one polynomial record, a power of two.

relations.quote: In this ring, products are computed by a signed form of [Cyclic convolution](cyclic-convolution.md): the coefficient lists are convolved, and any term that wraps past index $r-1$ returns with a minus sign.
